描述_EN: the splashed glazes resemble similar patterns found on textile tie-dyeing and batik of the same period. it has an incised decoration of floral motifs and a coloured lead glaze, also known as sancai or 'three colours'. similar examples have been found in graves of high standing citizens all over china. this earthenware pillow was specifically made for burials.
描述_ZN: 溅出的釉面类似于同一时期的纺织品扎染和蜡染上的类似图案。 它有一个刻画的花卉图案和彩色铅釉，也被称为三彩或 "三色"。 在中国各地有地位的公民的坟墓中都发现了类似的例子。 这个陶制枕头是专门为墓葬制作的。
